title: Tesla says it will start selling Cybercabs by end of year | TechCrunch
summary: If both timelines hold, it would mean third-party fleet customers would be able to buy the autonomous Cybercab and potentially operate it as a robotaxi service before Tesla owners would get access to the same autonomous capability in their own cars.
